A 21 year-old woman suffered a traffic accident that took her life. The young woman was driving under the influence. In light of this tragedy, in order to avoid future accidents, Congress passed a zero tolerance policy, establishing that "if the breathalyzer detects any trace of alcohol, the vehicle will be seized and the driver subject to imprisonment." Andrea is late to work, because she did not hear her alarm. While getting ready as fast as she can, Andrea uses mouthwash that contains alcohol. Despite her tardiness, Andrea drives carefully. When she is almost at her workplace, she is stopped by the police at a checkpoint. The breathalyzer test detects a small amount of alcohol. Did the person break the stated rule? Predict the participant's YES/NO answer.
